custom.system_prompt: You are generating conversations about moving house.

initial_prompt: Create a collaborative discussion about moving a house, with all the problems it may bring as well as new and unique opportunities.

variations.context: Moving into a first home after years of renting

setting.relationship_dynamic: First-time homeowners preparing to leave a rental
setting.background: They have purchased their first home and need to move while also dealing with repairs, utilities, and unfinished work at the property
setting.conversation_style: Excited planning mixed with uncertainty about responsibilities they have not encountered before

scenario_template.note: They celebrate getting their first home and discuss the moving date. No assistant is present or addressed in this scenario. The people resolve everything between themselves, or leave it unresolved. Never say 'Sigma'.
